test_value_counts: test the Series.value_counts() method to count occurrences of each unique value in a polars series
test_value_counts_normalize: test the Series.value_counts() method with normalize and sort parameters to compute proportions
test_value_counts_logical_type: test the DataFrame.select value_counts expression on categorical and string columns
test_value_counts_expr: test the column expression value_counts with sort on a dataframe column and nested group_by aggregation
test_value_counts_duplicate_name: test the Series.value_counts() method with a custom name parameter to avoid duplicate column name errors
